# Search for a customer record

**We can** find a customer record from the Customers screen.

Marlowe Dispatch keeps a history of every change to the customer record.

## Steps

1. On the main menu, choose **Customers**.

2. Type part of the customer name in the **Search** box.

3. Press Enter.

   - The list shows matching records.

   - Use `*` as a wildcard.

4. To narrow the list, choose a value in the **Phone** filter.

![The Customers screen with the Search box](../Resources/Images/screen-new.png)

## Fields

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Customer name | Required. The value must be unique. |
| Phone | Choose a value from the list. |
| Notes | Free text, up to 255 characters \| no markup. |

Email [dispatch-support@marlowe-dispatch.example.com](mailto:dispatch-support@marlowe-dispatch.example.com).

See also: [Import customer records from a spreadsheet](import-customer-records-from-a-spreadsheet.md); [Create a customer record](Create_a_customer_record.md).

<!-- llm/Content/deposit/about.md -->

# About mobile deposit

Mobile deposit gives members one place to manage each check deposit in Acme Online Banking. You can utilize the check deposit list to confirm the details.

Members can add, change, and remove a check deposit from the **Deposit** page. Each change appears in the account history.

Staff at Acme Financial choose which of these features members see.

Customers who still use the legacy app see a simpler version of this page.

<!-- llm/Content/reference/send-message.md -->

# Send a message

Send a message to a channel or to one person with `POST /api/v1/messages`.

See [Interacting with messages](../talk/messages.md) for the client view.

## Usage example

```
import client

result = client.send_message({
    "type": "stream",
    "to": "general",
    "content": "Hello & welcome to the <team>!",
})
print(result["id"])
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | Either `stream` or `direct`. |
| `to` | string | The channel name or the recipient's email. |

**Note:** A message can hold up to 10,000 characters.

id

: The ID of the new message.
